title: Check how constraint violations and SQL errors surface through ZtdPdo
question: Does ZtdPdo raise PDOException with the native SQLSTATE/driver code (23000/1062 for duplicate keys, 1364 for NOT NULL, 42000/1064 for syntax errors) and honour PDO::ERRMODE_SILENT/WARNING, or does it raise ZtdPdoException with code 0 as ZtdMysqli does (#485)?
next_action: An ad hoc probe in CYC-20260926T200050738102Z saw ZtdPdo::exec() raise ZtdQuery\Adapter\Pdo\ZtdPdoException code 0 for a duplicate primary key on MySQL (not retained as a run). Write an expectation from native PDO behaviour and PR #213 (simulation failures translated to the configured database exception), cover MySQL, SQLite and PostgreSQL with native controls and all three error modes, then report or link #485.
done_when: Each error case and error mode has a native control and ZTD observation on a supported runtime; confirmed divergences are reported upstream or linked to an existing issue.
